scope: Linux/VSCodium. Final integration of application sources, policy scopes, protected bridge, metadata mutations and simultaneous config leases; T89 acceptance is still pending.

checks.native_installed: Exact final installed-profile results and archive hash are in the external receipt.

vsix.checksum_note: Receipt stays outside the archive to avoid a self-referential checksum.

behavior.source_observation: Reuse the ProjectWatcher source filter for AnalysisContext sources outside the selected metadata session; dispose source/manifest observers with the language session.
behavior.permission_scopes: Existing SupportContexts cover backend-resolved application roots. Reuse an already opened project scope. Disabled policy creates no extra Metadata index; enabled policy fails closed until the target scope is ready. LSP startup does not await it.
behavior.selected_application: Direct production controller selection replaces the owned LSP and diagnostics and is remembered on manual restart. Quick Pick keyboard UI is not automated.
behavior.two_windows: Both hold the same real managed config; incompatible replacement is refused until the other owner releases it. Metadata trees, other client and config bytes are preserved.
behavior.protected_bridge: Actual own LSP read providers, readonly view and native alias denial; delay a real upstream hover reply, change its source and reject the late result; restart restores providers.
behavior.metadata_mutation: Actual metadata/propertyEditing and metadata/updateProperty with policy enabled. Dispose only the ESKA ProjectWatcher to isolate the metadata/changed path; Global toggles real BSL definition resolution with preserved LSP/Metadata PIDs and byte-identical XML restoration.

evidence_scope.native: Real editor, project and published analyzer; own unique small Designer XML fixtures. Runner checks every recorded PID after shutdown.
evidence_scope.guards: Separate native dirty-buffer and late-provider checks use controlled fake public providers; they do not claim upstream computation.
evidence_scope.server_apply: Injected payloads through public workspace middleware with real editor transactions, as in the previous edits report.
evidence_scope.diagnostics: Specific rapid-edit/context scenarios pass; published 0.3.2 omits push diagnostic versions, so this is not a proof of every possible race.
evidence_scope.performance: No buhmfo timing, memory or overhead claim is made by T88.

remaining: T89 final matrix of minimal CI/IDE installations, component packages and direct/wrapper equivalence.
Fair buhmfo comparison with frozen baseline: at least five cold and five repeat openings, 30 correct operations, median/p95, RSS/PSS, CPU/disk/cache and installed size.
